bias.en: Rebound · MACD up, capped at the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 向上，受制于 10 日均线

read.en: MP Materials rose 0.7% on Nov 11 to $36.73, trading $36.71–38.25. It is above the 5-day ($36.02) and below the 10-day ($37.34), 30-day ($40.72), 100-day ($48.06) and 200-day ($53.98), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 9, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 3 ($39.91), and RSI is 40.2.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月11日上涨 0.7%，收于 $36.73，盘中区间 $36.71–38.25。股价位于 5 日均线（$36.02）上方，10 日（$37.34）、30 日（$40.72）、100 日（$48.06）和 200 日均线（$53.98）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月9日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月3日起看空（$39.91），RSI 为 40.2。

read.en: No level changed: the $38.25 high pierced the $37.8–38.1 resistance, but the close fell back to the day's low, under the 10-day. Resistance is $37.3–38.3 (10-day, Jul 29 low, Nov 9 and Nov 11 highs), then $39–39.9 (Nov 4 high, SAR) and $40.7 (30-day). Support is $35.6–36.0 (5-day, Nov 4 and Nov 10 lows), then $33.8 and $31.9 (52-week low). A close above $38.3 would target $39–40; below $35.6, $33.8.
read.zh: 关键价位未变：盘中高点 $38.25 刺穿 $37.8–38.1 阻力，但收盘回落至当日低点附近，位于 10 日均线下方。阻力为 $37.3–38.3（10 日均线、7月29日低点、11月9日和11月11日高点），其次 $39–39.9（11月4日高点、抛物线 SAR）和 $40.7（30 日均线）。支撑为 $35.6–36.0（5 日均线、11月4日和11月10日低点），其次 $33.8 和 $31.9（52 周低点）。若收盘站上 $38.3，下一目标看 $39–40；若跌破 $35.6，则看 $33.8。

r.en: 10-day average $37.34; Jul 29 low $37.81; Nov 9 high $38.06; Nov 11 high $38.25
